✨ Industry-Grade Haskell Local LLM Engine

Type-Safe, Streaming AI for Haskell Developers

Connect Haskell applications to locally-running LLMs via Ollama. Featuring high-throughput Conduit streaming, Generic JSON Schema derivation, Model Context Protocol (MCP), and STM conversation storage.
